ipMode.description:
Indicates the IP mode of the cluster.
Possible values are defined in the `IpMode` enum and include:
- `IPv4`: The cluster operates in IPv4 mode.
- `IPv6`: The cluster operates in IPv6 mode.
- `DualStack`: The cluster supports both IPv4 and IPv6.

title:
